customer.name: Contoso Retail
customer.context: Regulated retail workloads containing customer and payment-adjacent data.

forbidden_resource_types.message: Customer workloads must not create direct public IP resources.
forbidden_resource_types.fix: Place the workload behind the approved private ingress or application gateway module.

attribute_rules.title: Storage public network access is disabled
attribute_rules.message: Storage accounts must not be reachable over a public endpoint.
attribute_rules.fix: Set `public_network_access_enabled = false` and add a private endpoint.

attribute_rules.title: Anonymous blob access is disabled
attribute_rules.message: Containers and blobs must not allow anonymous public access.

attribute_rules.title: Key Vault purge protection is enabled
attribute_rules.message: Key Vaults must resist immediate permanent deletion.

attribute_rules.title: Production databases are zone redundant
attribute_rules.message: Customer databases require zone-redundant high availability.
